warning: In the page model the batch (64) and d_model (64) are the same number. To know which is which, look at the position: the batch is always the first axis.

steps.title: Token ids
steps.text: The digits and “=” become ids. There is one sequence: the words will be written after “=”.

steps.title: Token embedding
steps.text: Each id picks one row of the embedding table: 6 numbers per token.

steps.title: Scale by √d_model
steps.text: Multiply by √6 ≈ 2.45. The table started with small numbers (about 1/√6), so after this step they are about the size of the position numbers.

steps.title: Add the positions
steps.text: Add row t of the fixed sine/cosine table to position t. This is how the same digit at position 0 and at position 1 would differ.

steps.title: LayerNorm 1 (pre-norm)
steps.text: Normalize each row before attention: mean 0, std 1, then a learned gain and shift (γ and β). x itself is kept for the residual.

steps.title: Q, K and V
steps.text: Three matrices (6 × 6, no bias) turn each normalized row into a query, a key and a value.

tensors.name: Q
tensors.note: The page model splits these 64 numbers into 4 heads of 16.

steps.title: Scores, with the causal mask
steps.text: Each row scores every earlier position and itself: Q Kᵀ / √d_k. Later positions are blocked (−∞), so “8” sees only itself and “=” sees all three.

tensors.name: scores = Q Kᵀ / √d_k
tensors.note: The page model has 4 heads, so its scores have a head axis.

steps.title: Attention weights
steps.text: Softmax along each row. Blocked scores get weight 0; every row sums to 1.

steps.title: Context
steps.text: weights @ V: each row is a mix of the value rows it may see.

steps.title: Output matrix W_O
steps.text: One more 6 × 6 matrix (with a bias). In the page model it also joins the 4 heads.

steps.title: Residual add
steps.text: x = x + attention output. The block adds to x; it never replaces it.

steps.title: LayerNorm 2
steps.text: Normalize again, this time before the FFN.

steps.title: FFN hidden
steps.text: Each row on its own: widen to d_ff = 12 numbers, then ReLU sets the negative ones to 0.

steps.title: FFN output
steps.text: Narrow back from 12 to 6 numbers per row.

steps.title: Residual add
steps.text: x = x + FFN output. This is the block's output. The page model has a second block here.

steps.title: Final LayerNorm
steps.text: One last LayerNorm after all the blocks, before the output layer.

steps.title: Output layer: logits
steps.text: A 6 × 42 matrix plus a bias gives one row of 42 scores per position. Only the last row (after “=”) picks the next token. The rows for “8” and “9” guess the next digit, which the loss ignores.

steps.title: Top tokens
steps.text: Softmax of the last row. The top token, “eighty”, is appended, and the model runs again on 4 tokens to write the next word.
